proposal.md.text:
## Why

PR229 head97db1db3 fixes ambient FFprobe usage but introduces macOS owned-header rejection. Controlled ancestor-alias reproduction confirms a mismatch between unresolved producer paths and canonical probe identities.

## What Changes

Canonicalize newly created private test roots before paths/hash keys in backend regression setup and combined workflow. Add cross-platform alias coverage; preserve strict probe and separate hermetic/genuine proof.

## Capabilities / Impact

Modify durable-production-requests hermetic acceptance: add an owned-root ancestor-alias scenario. Only two private TypeScript test files and specs/evidence change; no public/persisted/runtime contract or migration.

## Non-goals

No production/native lifecycle/disposal, shared probe/backend, dependencies, workflows, profiles, timeouts, skips or weaker negatives. Preserve archives/failed CI. Windows disposal remains restricted. No PR approval, merge/deploy, readiness change or denied description/comments.

design.md.text:
## Decision

Immediately realpath each newly created owned root before child paths, manifest keys or configuration. Change only tests/artwork-durable-backends.test.ts setup and tests/artwork-durable-workflow.ts root creation; parameterize the private setup parent for regression coverage. No new abstraction.

## Boundaries / alternatives

Keep artwork-durable-probe.mjs and fake-media-tool.mjs byte-identical. Do not canonicalize arbitrary probe inputs into acceptance or relax containment, identity, hash, type, size or format controls. Root-only manifest normalization still fails the controlled reproduction; relaxing the probe masks escapes and is rejected.

Create an owned physical parent plus ancestor alias (Windows junction, otherwise directory symlink). Canonical producer PNG/WAV paths must pass with empty PATH; allowlisted explicit alias paths, foreign files and same-root/foreign linked child directories must fail. Existing leaf-link and malformed/changed/unknown/oversize/configuration controls remain, with no new skips.

## Verification / risk

Red-before-green regression; full bridge checks; separate source/package hermetic and genuine proof, plus aliased TMPDIR/no-ambient controls. Linux does not prove Windows/macOS. No production/public/persisted/security boundary changes, dependency or migration. Fail explicitly; no fallback. Rollback only the private test diff; preserve raw failed CI/history.

specs/durable-production-requests/spec.m.text:
## MODIFIED Requirements

### Requirement: Hermetic combined acceptance with retained genuine-media proof
Combined artwork/narration/durable source and package acceptance MUST use actual core and explicitly configured test backends in hermetic mode without ambient media tools, readiness skips or weakened common assertions. Probe facts MUST derive from bounded validated owned bytes. Explicit genuine mode MUST retain independent FFmpeg decoding and require explicit genuine tools. Evidence MUST distinguish modes; runtime, gates, profiles, timeouts and historical oracles SHALL remain unchanged. A host temporary-directory ancestor alias MUST NOT reject otherwise valid owned fixtures; unsafe input identities MUST still fail closed.

#### Scenario: Hermetic source and package
- **WHEN** ambient media tools are absent and configured fake backends are supplied
- **THEN** the complete combined scenario passes, checking exact fake output and all common assertions without claiming pixels

#### Scenario: Explicit genuine source and package
- **WHEN** genuine mode is selected
- **THEN** explicit genuine tools independently decode the actual64x64 frame; missing tools fail without fallback/skip and common assertions remain

#### Scenario: Invalid configuration or fixture
- **WHEN** configured tools are absent or a probe input is unknown, malformed, changed or outside owned bounds/root
- **THEN** acceptance fails explicitly without ambient fallback or fabricated success

#### Scenario: Owned temporary-root ancestor alias
- **WHEN** an owned test fixture is created through a host temporary-directory ancestor alias
- **THEN** ordinary canonical owned PNG/WAV paths succeed with empty PATH while explicit alias inputs, linked children, foreign files and all existing invalid inputs remain rejected
